 The Philadelphia 76ers are fresh off a win over the defending champs. On Thursday, it’ll be the first appearance for LeBron James and Jaylen Brown at home as Sixers. We are looking at a few trends for your 76ers predictions , including how James performs when joining a new team.
 First Home Games in James’ Career
 James is looking to become the first player to win championships with four different franchises. This will be his fifth home debut if you include his return to the Cleveland Cavaliers.

 Nothing overwhelmingly stands out. He’s a seasoned player that’s going to play within himself offensively. One takeaway is the minutes he’ll get early in the season. When James plays at least 34 minutes (his time on the floor against the Knicks), his teams win 62.1% of the time. 
 76ers Success When Embiid Gets Minutes
 We can also make value of the Kalshi promo code by looking at minutes from Joel Embiid. He got 33 minutes in his appearance against the Knicks.
 If that’s close to the case for their home opener, then the 76ers have an even better chance of getting a win.  Below, we look at how the Sixers have performed when Embiid gets at least 33 minutes on the court.

 Cavaliers Returning Mitchell and Harden
 The Cavaliers have slight changes to the roster, but their core is back with Donovan Mitchell and James Harden. 
 We always think of Harden being an aggressive scorer, but keep in mind that Mitchell is the one averaging more points in their 22 appearances together . Mitchell is averaging 26 points, while Harden is at 19.9 points per game. They are 16-6 in that span, which includes 18 playoff games.
 Create Kalshi Combos with Nuggets-Thunder Matchup
 Use the Kalshi combos feature to include additional markets from the late matchup as the Oklahoma City Thunder take on the Denver Nuggets.
 Two of the best players in the NBA will meet in Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Nikola Jokic. These early season-performances will have an impact on the future MVP markets .
 Above, you’ll see all the players that have over a 10% chance to win the regular-season MVP award. It’s important to note that Gilgeous-Alexander dropped 32 points on the road in their opener. And in his l ast five appearances against the Nuggets, he is averaging 34.4 points per game.
